results.interpretation: Descriptive reduced-round evidence only. An exact binomial p-value is calculated for the maximum-deviation output bit; Bonferroni correction covers 256 output-bit tests (and all sweep configurations when run as a sweep). Statistical bias is not a full-round SHA-256 break, not a preimage/collision result, and not a consensus-compatible mining shortcut.
